ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.

1.

City-run programs
9B.
Commission Calendar -- Arts Division Manager Murphy
1.
Wednesdays@Noon: June 4, 11, 18, and 25, 2025, July 2, 9, 16, 23, and 30, 2025, Encinitas Library
2.
North Coast Symphony Orchestra Concert With Winners of the Youth Piano Competition: June 14, 2025 at 2:30pm, Encinitas Community Center
3.
Summer Art Camp: June 16-August 8, 2025, weekly Monday-Friday, 9:00am-3:00pm, Pacific View Arts Center
4.
Music by the Sea concert: June 27 at 7:00pm, Encinitas Library
5.
Tramonto Classical Music Festival: July 18 and 19, 2025 at 7:00pm, and July 20, 2025 at 2:00pm, Encinitas Library

7.
Moonlight Beach Concerts: July 13 and 27, 2025 and August 10 and 24, 2025, 1:00-5:00pm, Moonlight Beach.
8.
Next Regular Commission Meeting: August 4, 2025 at 5:00pm, Council Chambers. There is no Regular Meeting held in July 2025.
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan.
1.
Discuss the 2025-26 Work Plan and provide updates.
2.
Discuss City Council-directed items:
1.
Generate ideas that could help generate revenue funding to contribute to the Pacific View Arts Center with a goal for this work plan year to be a list
of ideas generated. If it can be taken all the way to a program, that would be a stretch goal.
2.
Recommend goals and policies for the Arts that are consistent with all the other General Plan elements. Add something called out in the Recreation
element that talks about arts.
3.
Discuss potential dates for a special meeting in September to hold a community workshop related to the City Council directed work plan goals.
4.
Discuss the City Mural Plan goal that includes research on feasibility and funding of a City Mural Program that includes program models, potential locations, outside funding sources, and public outreach methods.
5.
Review and discuss proposed donation of public art mural by artist Preston Pollard.
6.
Form ad hoc committees as needed to complete work plan goals.
8A. Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan
